candidates.change_summary: Require a different exact msg.value (5 ether instead of 10 ether), so fallback accepts different payments and thus changes state when called with 5 ether.
Remove the time check so fallback can update pastBlockTime even when block.timestamp is not greater, altering observable state after calls that would previously revert.
Change assignment to set pastBlockTime to block.number instead of block.timestamp, producing a different stored value observable via the public getter.
Remove the conditional transfer so the contract never sends its balance back in the divisible-by-15 block case, changing observable outcomes for callers expecting a payout.
Invert the divisibility check so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 instead of when it equals 0, changing when callers receive the balance.
